_comment: The user-account rules as data (WORKORDER-userSqlAndSaveHole-111026). Read by lib/user-profile-rules.js, which refuses at load if any entry is missing. selfEditablePropertyList is what POST /api/saveUserData lets a signed-in user change on their OWN record; anything else in the body is refused by name, never dropped. html/stores/loginStore.js SELF_EDITABLE_PROPERTY_LIST must equal it (gate B1 of server/test/user-sql-and-save-hole.test.js).
_selfEditablePropertyList: the profile page's own fields (components/form_profile.vue). username, role and refId are never self-editable: role and username change only through the admin tools, and the record is always the signed-in user's own.
_ownRecordPropertyName: the one property outside the list a body may carry: the record's own identifier, accepted only when it equals the signed-in user's refId (the write is keyed on the token's refId either way).
_currentPasswordPropertyName: the property that must accompany a new password: the CURRENT password, verified against the stored hash before the new one is hashed and saved, so a stolen session cannot change the password (ROMANTIC_PARASOL ruling 2026-11-10). Never saved; refused in a body that carries no new password.
_passwordPropertyName: the users table's password property (profile-user maps it under the same name). It must be in selfEditablePropertyList; a non-blank value there is a NEW password.
_adminEditablePropertyList: what admin-create-user and admin-update-user accept (the admin user form sends exactly these; the rater tool sends a subset); anything else is refused by name (propertyNotAdminEditable), never dropped (re-verification 2026-11-10).
_maxLengthByPropertyName: the longest value each self-editable property may hold, refused by name above it (propertyTooLong) BEFORE any save (review SF-7: a 100000-character first name was saved, and every later reply re-signed it into the authtoken header until Node refused the header, locking the account). Every self-editable property must have an entry. password matches validatePasswordStrength's own ceiling. username (2026-11-20) bounds self-registration and the admin tools alike. applicationComment (WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126 A8, 2026-11-21) is the optional note an applicant leaves for the approvers.
_emailPatternText: the email rule for the self-save path, the same pattern admin-create-user and admin-update-user apply (review N-2).
_usernamePatternText: the username rule for admin-create-user and admin-update-user, as it stood in both before it moved here (2026-11-10). Production held no username outside it that day.
_loginRefusalNameByAccountState: what sign-in answers for each value of users.disabled that is an account STATE rather than an admin's disabling (WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126). Read by the website login (user-login) and the OAuth sign-in page (oidc-verify-credential). Any other set value is accountDisabled; blank, '0' and 'false' are active. Every refusal named here must be in refusalByCase.
_approverRoleList: the roles that may see and decide account applications (WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126 A5). Read from the approver's users row in the database, never from the request or the token's claims.
_approvalDecisionByName: the decisions an approver may make on a self-registered account (WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126): fromStateList is the users.disabled values it may be made from ('' is active), toStateText what it sets. A declined account can be approved later; an approved (active) account cannot be declined here, it is disabled through the admin user tools instead (decided 2026-11-21, so approval never becomes a second way to disable an account in use). An account still awaiting its email confirmation is not decidable: approvers are asked only about proved addresses (A2).
_refusalByCase: every refusal this module makes: refusalName is the stable name a caller tests, reason is what a person reads, httpStatus is what the endpoint answers. <!detailListText!> is filled with the property names refused, or the password rule's complaints.

noSignedInUser.reason: the sign-in names no user record to save to

bodyNotAnObject.reason: a profile save must send a JSON object of the properties to change

notOwnRecord.reason: a profile save may change only the signed-in user's own record

propertyNotSelfEditable.reason: these cannot be changed from the profile page: <!detailListText!>

usernameNotAllowed.reason: a username may contain only letters, numbers, underscore and hyphen

identifierNotText.reason: a user lookup was given an identifier that is not text: <!detailListText!>

passwordNotAccepted.reason: the new password was not accepted: <!detailListText!>

propertyNotAdminEditable.reason: these cannot be set by the admin user tools: <!detailListText!>

emailAdrNotValid.reason: the email address is not in a valid form

sessionRevoked.reason: this sign-in ended when the account's password was changed; please sign in again

noSuchUser.reason: no user record has that refId

currentPasswordRequired.reason: a new password is saved only with the current password

currentPasswordWrong.reason: the current password given is not this account's password

refusalByCase._registrationAndReset: the refusals of self-registration and password reset (PLAN-userRegistrationReset-112026). linkNotValid covers an unknown, altered, used or expired link alike, so a refusal tells a guesser nothing about which.
refusalByCase._accountMailNotSent: WORKORDER-accountMailFailureAndApprovalNotice-112326 M3: a mail the person is waiting for (password reset, sign-up confirmation, resend confirmation) failed to go, after email-sender's one retry. The reset and resend forms answer it as this refusal; registration (the account IS created) answers 200 with mailOutcome accountMailNotSent. tqii accepted that on the reset form this reveals an account exists, but only during a mail outage. 503: try again later.

accountMailNotSent.reason: We could not send the email just now. Please try again in a few minutes.

registrationNotConfigured.reason: account registration and password reset are not set up on this server

registrationDisabled.reason: new accounts cannot be created here at present

emailNotConfirmed.reason: this account's email address has not been confirmed yet; follow the link we emailed, or ask for a new one

linkNotValid.reason: this link is not valid: it may have expired or already been used; please ask for a new one

tooManyRequests.reason: too many requests; please try again in <!detailListText!> seconds

usernameTaken.reason: that username is already in use

emailAdrTaken.reason: an account already uses that email address; you can reset its password instead

accountDisabled.reason: this account is disabled; please contact the site's administrators

refusalByCase._adminApproval: the refusals of admin approval of new registrations (WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126). awaitingApproval and accountNotApproved are given at sign-in only once the password has proved right.

awaitingApproval.reason: this account is waiting for an administrator to approve it; you will get an email when that is decided

accountNotApproved.reason: this account was not approved; please contact the site's administrators

notAnApprover.reason: only an administrator can see or decide account applications

approvalDecisionNotValid.reason: a decision must be approve or decline, for one account (userRefId), with sendDeclineEmail true or false

approvalNotDecidable.reason: this account cannot be given that decision in its present state: <!detailListText!>
